title: QA Pilot Checklist Review Packet
description: Schema for QA Pilot checklist review packets. A review packet summarizes an evidence checklist (#44) into an Owner-facing decision surface. It reports checklist identity, item counts by state (blocked/degraded/ready), source evidence references, and explicit authority boundary assertions. Advisory-only, QA Pilot-local custody, no Librarian mutation.

source_checklist_id.description: The evidence checklist this packet reviews (must reference an existing EC-* ID).

title.description: Human-readable title for this review packet.

description.description: What this review packet covers and the context of the review.

item_summary.description: Count of checklist items by readiness state. total = blocked + degraded + ready.

overall_state.description: Aggregate readiness state. 'blocked' if any required item is blocked, 'degraded' if any required item is degraded and none blocked, 'ready' if all required items are ready.

source_evidence_refs.description: References to the evidence sources that informed this review.

blocked_items.description: Items that are blocked, with rationale. Present if any blocked items exist.

advisory_only.description: All QA Pilot review packets are advisory. Must be true.

librarian_impact.description: No Librarian mutation permitted. Must be none.

not_seal_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this packet does not confer sealing authority. Must be at least 20 characters.

not_librarian_mutation_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this packet does not authorize Librarian mutation. Must be at least 20 characters.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this review packet was created.

created_by.description: Agent or tool that created this review packet.

pipeline_refs.description: References to the sealed pipeline layers that source this review.

allOf.description: total must equal blocked + degraded + ready.
If any blocked items exist, blocked_items must be present and non-empty.
